verdict_detail: Real-but-non-graduating. Make-or-break decile test FAILED: extreme top (D10) is flat/inverted, NOT top-concentrated. AX-007 wall holds for the monthly-carry construction. ONE real sub-signal isolated: fresh-disclosure-month drift. Route = FR_RCMA event-cohort / DPL_FEATURE, NOT capital graduation.
confidence_vector_note: Cross-sectional rank-IC = 0.0007 (ICIR 0.004, Harvey-t 0.067) => effectively zero predictive confidence for the monthly-carry confirmed-buyback score. Per-name confidence not emitted as a deployable vector; signal does not pass screening. Confidence is meaningful ONLY in the fresh-disclosure cohort (see spike_survival).

factor_specs.proxy: BuybackYield_Confirmed = (TTM_4Q buyback KRW notional / MktCap) * 1{M03 > cross-sectional median}
factor_specs.formula: score_i = clip(SBB_ttm_i / Size_i, 0, 0.5) * (M03_i > median_t(M03)); SBB_ttm = rolling 4Q trailing sum of .cache/stock_buyback.parquet Value; M03 = Close(t)/Close(t-3m)-1
factor_specs.lag_rule: buyback Factor_Date = Period_Date + 45d (C4, asof Factor_Date <= sig_date); price t-1; forward Ret_1m (C2)
factor_specs.neutralization: Size-normalized (yield basis); cross-sectional median gate per month (C1)
factor_specs.economic_rationale: Buyback = costly credible insider commitment + mechanical demand + Ikenberry post-announcement underreaction drift; M03 gate intended to filter defensive value-trap buybacks. Buy-side only (escapes AX-007 no-short trap). EMPIRICAL RESULT: the drift exists ONLY in the fresh-disclosure month (+0.42%/mo) and is diluted to zero by the 3-month quarterly carry (carry months -0.28%/mo); the M03 gate does not improve and slightly harms (base PORT_t 0.015 < ungated 0.36).
factor_specs.redundancy_cluster_id: event_buyback_drift (NEW; not in M* factor family; no M* factor uses buyback)

diagnostics.metric_type: canonical_screen (canonical_screen_bt -> build_benchmark_compare, NW lag-3). NOT forge-authoritative; admission requires forge build_bt_result.
diagnostics.ic_t_vs_portfolio_alpha_t_note: Both rank-IC t (0.067) and portfolio-alpha t (0.015) are near zero and AGREE: no signal. No divergence to reconcile (unlike Cycle 2).

decile_test.status: FAILED — make-or-break: top NOT concentrated, flat/inverted
decile_test.procedure: per-month drop score==0, decile-rank confirmed score over active subset (median 47 active names/mo), forward 1M EW net active (decile - BM).
decile_test.interpretation: D10 (highest buyback-yield-confirmed) earns -0.7% annualized active (flat/negative). D9 (+3.7%) > D10. D10-D9 gap is NEGATIVE and insignificant (t=-0.60). The extreme top does NOT add beyond merely-high — concentration is anti-helpful. This is honest_risk #1 (TOP-GOES-FLAT: KR buybacks are defensive value-trap survivors) realized. The AX-007 wall (real signal stranded short/mid-decile) holds for this monthly-carry construction — though here even mid-deciles are noisy, the dominant read is no top-concentration.

spike_survival.status: THE ONE REAL SUB-SIGNAL — disclosure-drift exists but carry dilutes it to zero
spike_survival.interpretation: Within D10, the active return is concentrated in the fresh-disclosure month (+0.42%/mo, ~+5%/yr) and turns NEGATIVE in carry months 2-3 (-0.28%/mo). The Ikenberry drift is real but SHORT-LIVED (~1 month); the monthly quarterly-carry construction averages the positive fresh pop with negative carry months => net zero. honest_risk #4 (quarterly-carry dilution) is the mechanism of failure, and the actionable lever for screen-route: trade ONLY the fresh-disclosure cohort.

ablations.interpretation: (i) The M03 confirm gate HURTS: ungated PORT_t (0.36) > M03-gated base (0.015). The 'confirmed' label adds nothing for M03 — per spec orthogonality_targets this means the gate should be dropped. (ii) Size-normalization MATTERS: raw KRW (un-normalized) PORT_t = -0.37 (worst), confirming the SBB/Size yield is the correct construction (raw just re-ranks toward large absolute-buyback large-caps). (iii) Longer-momentum gates monotonically improve (M03 0.015 < M06 0.55 < M12 0.79) and longer TTM (8Q 0.66) helps — but ALL remain far below the 2.0 screening / 2.95 graduation thresholds. No variant is graduate-able.

gate_fill_frequency.interpretation: Gate over-thinning (honest_risk #2) is NOT the failure cause: median 47 active names/mo, only 4/257 months fall below 25 (ungated fill rarely triggered). The failure is genuine flatness, not a thinning artifact.

orthogonality.basis: active (-BM) net return series, monthly, n=255 (kr_factor_returns_v2)
orthogonality.interpretation: PASSES all orthogonality targets on active basis: |corr| vs momentum 0.073 (<<0.40 — NOT repackaged momentum, the gate did not re-introduce momentum-beta), vs value 0.011 (<<0.35 — buyback-specific not value-beta), vs size 0.205 (<0.35). The signal is genuinely buyback-specific and orthogonal to the M* family — but orthogonal-to-nothing-useful: it is orthogonal AND has no alpha (measurement-graduation §6: orthogonal != return; PORT_t is the binding gate and it fails). corr 0.80 vs unconfirmed confirms the gate adds no incremental value.

dsr_note: selection_type='single' (one hypothesis-driven alpha, n_trials~1; the ablations are IS-only diagnostic variants, NOT a sweep picking a winner for graduation). DSR gate does NOT apply (measurement-graduation §3). Overfit defense = oos_retention (=-1.30, FAIL <0.5) + holdout. Moot: signal has no IS alpha to overfit.

graduation_assessment.conclusion: NOT a graduate-candidate. Clean, decisive negative on the deployable construction. NOTE (canonical_screen is screening-grade, not forge-authoritative — but the numbers are so far below every threshold that a forge build_bt_result would not change the verdict).

screen_route_recommendation.rationale: 1. The fresh-disclosure-month drift (+0.42%/mo, orthogonal to M*/value/size) is a REAL short-lived event signal worth carrying as a DPL input feature (research_philosophy ④: failed standalone alpha = DPL feature). 2. As an event-cohort overlay: trade only the fresh-disclosure cohort (1-month holding) rather than monthly carry — this isolates the +5%/yr fresh pop from the -3.3%/yr carry drag. This is a distinct construction (not tested here as deployable; flagged for a follow-up event-driven WT). NOT a capital-graduation candidate in its monthly-carry form.

honest_risks_realized.1_TOP_GOES_FLAT: REALIZED (primary failure). D10 flat/inverted, D10-D9 gap negative.
honest_risks_realized.2_GATE_OVER_THINNING: NOT realized — median 47 active/mo, fill rarely triggered.
honest_risks_realized.3_MOMENTUM_REDUNDANCY: NOT realized — corr vs momentum 0.073, genuinely orthogonal.
honest_risks_realized.4_QUARTERLY_CARRY_DILUTION: REALIZED (mechanism of failure) — fresh +0.42% vs carry -0.28%; carry dilutes the disclosure drift to zero.
honest_risks_realized.5_SIZE_NORM_ARTIFACT: Mitigated — Size-normalized yield outperforms raw KRW; not a micro-cap artifact (adv>=2e8 + clip).
honest_risks_realized.6_SPARSE_EVENT: NOT a problem — median 47 active names/mo across 257 months, floor never <15.

challenge_flags.detail: Make-or-break decile test failed: D10 PORT_t -0.40, D10-D9 gap t -0.60, monotonicity 0.48. The campaign's first top-concentration-DESIGNED concept still does NOT show a top-concentrated graduating signal in monthly-carry form.
M03 confirm gate lowers PORT_t (0.015) below ungated (0.36). Per spec, gate should be dropped; the 'confirmed' label is not earned for M03.
Fresh-disclosure-month drift +0.42%/mo is real and orthogonal but the monthly-carry construction dilutes it to zero. Screen-route as event-cohort/DPL feature, not capital.
